ingest.note: Receives transcribed text from STT. Streaming messages API.

egress.note: Streams text tokens to TTS. Use stream=True for low-latency first-token.

interruption.description: On interruption, cancel the in-flight streaming message. Claude's streaming API supports cancellation.
interruption.code_hint: Pipecat: LLMContextAggregator handles this automatically. LiveKit: session handles cancellation. Custom: close the streaming response.

potholes.note: Claude uses a separate 'system' parameter (not a system message in the messages array). Pipecat and LiveKit handle this automatically.
Claude Sonnet 4 supports extended thinking. For voice agents, disable thinking (thinking={'type': 'disabled'}) to reduce latency.

cost_estimates.notes: Est. ~250 tokens/min at Sonnet 4.6 pricing ($3/1M in, $15/1M out)
